notes:
v1.0.85 - Portable share codes, tray keep-alive, Music & Spotify, UI rebuilds:
1) SHARE CODES FIXED FOR REAL: codes are now self-contained (the whole profile is compressed into the code) - they import on ANY PC even offline, no more "works here, fails there".
2) THE LAUNCHER NEVER DIES WHILE YOU PLAY: new system tray - closing the window (or a renderer crash) hides to the tray instead of quitting, and the app stays alive while a game runs. Quit only from the tray menu.
3) MUSIC & SPOTIFY (Settings -> Audio): drop your own .mp3/.flac/.ogg into the launcher for background music, OR connect Spotify (free Client ID from developer.spotify.com, PKCE auth, tokens encrypted, Premium required). New startup song composed for the splash animation.
4) PERFORMANCE: Xaero Minimap/World Map get a performance-first seed at launch (the 110->88 fps map drop is gone); mod descriptions render badges/images cleanly instead of raw markdown; duplicate-install confirm now renders above all modals.
5) SETTINGS REORGANIZED + CREDITS PAGE: sections reordered; Advanced is now a proper animated Credits page (creator @MoustachePetit, contributor @Fasticraft_MC).
6) UI REBUILDS (same colors, same actions): Downloads (live hero with artwork, speed & ETA, grouped history), Home (glass hero with glowing portrait), Play (glowing play card), Account (new Refresh session / Copy UUID / Microsoft account actions).
